state_definitions.exact_span: source_quote is an exact character substring of the declared source
state_definitions.missing: the declared source or source_quote is unavailable
state_definitions.normalized_excerpt: source_quote matches after whitespace collapse and case-folding but has no exact span
state_definitions.synthesized_or_multi_span: reserved for an explicit future human declaration; never inferred mechanically
state_definitions.unresolved: a nonempty quote and source exist, but the declared excerpt cannot be located mechanically
